caption_hook: 🏃‍♀️ At 93, sprinter Emma Mazzenga has muscle fibres as big as a woman in her 20s, scientists found + 3 more wins 👇
question: What's your secret to staying young? Reply with one word
share_line: Send this to the friend who says they're too old to start
first_comment: Bonus: Emma took a 30-year break from running, then came back at 53 and kept going while her friends quit. She still trains 3 times a week. What would you start at 53? 🏃‍♀️

stories.headline: At 93, a sprinter's muscle fibres match a woman in her 20s
stories.summary: Emma Mazzenga holds the over-90 world record for 200 m. Scientists found her fitness level matches someone in their 50s, and her fatigue-resistant muscle fibres are as big as a 20-something's.
stories.why: She restarted running at 53. Researchers hope she shows how much ageing is avoidable.

stories.stat_label: years ago, a volcano hit Japan
stories.headline: After a 7,300-year-old eruption, some ancient Japanese thrived
stories.summary: The undersea Kikai-Akahoya eruption buried Japan in ash. A new study finds Jomon survivors moved to the northern Kyushu coast, turned to the sea for food, and their population kept growing.
stories.why: Even after a catastrophe, people adapted and built new lives.

stories.headline: Bili, a gorilla seized from traffickers, is heading back to the wild
stories.summary: Rescued as a sick baby in a 2023 sting in Nigeria, Bili was flown to a Jane Goodall Institute sanctuary in Congo. She raced into the forest and climbed trees. The plan: a gorilla friend, then the wild.
stories.why: Over 80% of trafficked baby gorillas don't survive. Bili did.

stories.headline: Ghost-white corals fully recovered in 7 weeks, a record
stories.summary: Stanford scientists let bleached corals touch healthy clones from the same colony. Their tissues fused, life-giving algae flowed in, and the bleached corals fully recovered. Those not touching died.
stories.why: It's the fastest coral recovery ever documented.

fun_fact: The Kikai-Akahoya eruption was the largest volcanic eruption on Earth in the last 10,000 years.
